I told Dana in #north-team that the documents give 185 seats for the 2026 Quarrendon renewal. I can't confirm the 261 Ilse posted.

The North team can see all of these sources, and Dana is the account owner. Nothing I posted is a finance figure; I left out prices and discounts.
- **Amendment No. 1** set Quarrendon at 185 seats from 2025-09-01.
- **The 2026 Renewal Order Form** (signed 2026-03-20, effective 2026-04-01, term to 2027-03-31) doesn't restate the seat count. That leaves 185 in place.
- **The account record** also shows 185 active seats.
- **Amendment No. 3** (signed 2026-09-22) raises it to 230 seats, but only from 2027-01-01.

I found 261 in no contract, amendment or account note. When Ilse posted it on the 14th, I replied "Noted" without checking it. In Dana's thread I said that was my mistake and asked Ilse where 261 came from. Until Ilse answers, I suggested Dana's tracker show 185 now and 230 from 2027-01-01.
